grid.layout_notes: 5×5 with bottom row locked (Wilds unlocking left-to-right per Ritual level) and Ritual Bar beneath.

win_system.notes: Tumble ways; xSplit (Dagger/Guillotine) can grow symbol size up to 32×. Exact base ways not stated in CMS.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Winning combinations destroyed; remaining tumble down; new symbols fall in.

other.name: Ritual Bar
other.how_it_works: 5 levels (20/30/40/60/80). Medium +1, high +2, Scatter +10 per symbol. Level-up removes lowest pays, converts medium→high; excess carries. Resets each new game round. Bottom locked Wilds unlock L→R per level.

other.name: xSplit Dagger/Guillotine
other.how_it_works: Dagger splits its row; Guillotine splits all symbols below on its reel. Appear with x2 mult; split symbols get multipliers; both become Wild after split. Max symbol size 32×.

wilds.name: Sticky Wild
wilds.behavior: Can land any reel. In Candle / Reign of Terror: drops to bottom and sticks until part of a win or new bet. Bottom locked row starts filled with Wilds unlocked per Ritual level.

scatters.name: Scatter
scatters.behavior: +10 Ritual Bar each. In Reign of Terror, Scatter awards +1 free spin.

specials.name: Dagger xSplit
specials.behavior: Splits its row; x2 on symbol; becomes Wild after split.

specials.name: Guillotine xSplit
specials.behavior: Splits all symbols below on its reel; x2; becomes Wild after split.

base_game_loop.summary: Tumble spin on 5×5 with locked bottom Wild row + Ritual Bar. Wins/Scatters fill bar through 5 levels; level-ups upgrade symbol set and unlock bottom Wilds. Levels 1–4 award +2 Candle Spins; level 5 enters Reign of Terror (+6 FS, high-pays only, xSplit). Optional Halifax buy, xBet boosters, Nolimit Bonus 100–500×.

phases.state_changes: Enter Candle or Reign of Terror

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
## Reel Area
5x5 reel setup with bottom row locked and a Ritual Bar beneath the bottom row. Bottom locked row is filled with Wild symbols and each level progression unlocks a Wild symbol starting from the left

Winning combinations will be destroyed and remaining symbols will tumble down, allowing the new symbols to fall in.

## Ritual Bar
There are 5 levels of progressions. The Ritual Bar resets for each level up. Exceeding collection will be carried over.

- Level 1: 20
- Level 2: 30
- Level 3: 40
- Level 4: 60
- Level 5: 80

Landing the Scatter symbols and winning combinations of medium and high paying symbols advances the Ritual bar.

- Medium paying symbol = +1 per winning symbol
- High paying symbol = +2 per winning symbol
- Scatter symbol = +10 per Scatter symbol

Each level removes the lowest paying symbols and also converts medium symbols to high paying symbols.

Ritual bar resets for every new game round.

## Candle Spins
Reaching a new level of the Ritual Bar awards +2 Candle Spins till level 4, +6 Free Spins when advancing to Reign of Terror Spins.

Before any new level, any plausible wins pay out before progressing to the next level.
